privacy_note.data_handled: Declares NSCameraUsageDescription, NSFaceIDUsageDescription, NSMicrophoneUsageDescription and NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription, plus exported types .fieldrecordbackup, .arreviewrequest, .arreviewresponse and .arenvelope. No CFBundleDocumentTypes and no photo-library key (PhotosPicker needs none).
privacy_note.storage: n/a (declarations only)
privacy_note.permissions: Camera and Face ID are requested by reachable code. Microphone and speech recognition are requested only by OnDevicePushToTalkVoiceCaptureAdapterV1, which production never constructs.
privacy_note.reachability: Camera and Face ID strings reachable; microphone and speech-recognition strings have no reachable requester.
privacy_note.v23_change: All four usage-description keys were added to Info.plist after S10 (S10 took its camera string from the INFOPLIST_KEY_NSCameraUsageDescription build setting, which is still present). Three exported types were added (C48 review exchange, C54 envelope).

privacy_note.data_handled: App entry: launch arguments, Application Support setup, startup routing, app access, camera, mail and MetricKit adapters.
privacy_note.storage: Creates Application Support; app-access preferences use UserDefaults.standard; a DEBUG-only path seeds a legacy test store.
privacy_note.permissions: Indirect: camera, Face ID/passcode (app lock), notifications (reminder settings, hidden by the shipping phase gate), MetricKit subscription.
privacy_note.v23_change: Adds the app-lock cover and settings, a phase-gated Reminders section and a DEBUG migration test store. Phase 1 UI tests add a DEBUG-only hook: with --v23-ui-test-local-auth-success and an accepted isolated UI-test store, a private test Local Authentication client that always succeeds is passed to AppAccessPresentationV1. The hook and client are compiled only in DEBUG; Release always passes nil and composes SystemLocalAuthenticationClient, so Release data, storage, network and permissions are unchanged.

global.network_clients: None under FieldEvidenceApp/ (no URLSession, URLRequest, Network framework, WebKit or SFSafariViewController). Outbound paths are OS- or user-mediated: StoreKit, user-sent mail, share sheet, Settings/App Store/tel/sms/mailto/Maps handoff, a local CoreSpotlight index and MetricKit.
global.third_party_dependencies: None: no Swift packages, CocoaPods, Carthage or embedded frameworks in the project.

open_release_items: PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy declares no NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategorySystemBootTime although OnDevicePushToTalkVoiceCaptureAdapterV1 (non-DEBUG, currently unreachable) reads ProcessInfo.systemUptime; S9_1ReleasePreflightTests also asserts app source never contains systemUptime.
Microphone and speech-recognition purpose strings have no reachable requester.
The camera purpose string exists both in Info.plist and in the INFOPLIST_KEY_NSCameraUsageDescription build setting.

Backup export adds V23 families (contact values, signoff typed names and roles, service requests, temporal-evidence records) to an unencrypted package; BackupExportView and EraseAllView copy still describe only S10 data types.
App Store privacy answers, archive privacy report and final owner signoff remain owner gates; nothing here is release evidence.
review_method: Source reading of each listed file and its V23 diff from accepted main b1d04ae5e684aa9c6807af655089efa1df8a7ed6; no build, archive or runtime capture.
